title: Pawn storms
line: Throwing pawns at the castled king, opening a file for the rooks; with the kings on opposite wings, whoever attacks first.

steps.text: The kings stand on opposite wings. Your pawns on the king's side do not shield your king, so they can attack.
Start the storm: push the rook's pawn two squares toward the black king.
steps.after: Black stops the pawn with a pawn of its own.

steps.text: Push the next pawn up to break that pawn away.
Push the rook's pawn again. It offers itself to open the file for your rook.
steps.after: The pawn is gone, but the file in front of your rook is open.

steps.text: The file in front of your rook is open now: it looks straight up at the black knight on h5. That is what the pawns were for.

summary: With the kings on opposite wings, throw the pawns in front of your rooks at the enemy king and open a file.
